stemMd:
Evaluate the following statement using only the passage, choosing an assessment with a sound justification:

Every interpreter working in S also works in R.

options.label: A
options.textMd: True: it follows from the passage.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Not deducible: the passage does not settle it.

options.label: C
options.textMd: False, because all 30 interpreters work in S.

explanationMd: Only 6 of the 16 S interpreters are in both groups, leaving 10 outside R.

distractorRationale.a: This requires a deduction the stated conditions do not support. Only 6 of the 16 S interpreters are in both groups, leaving 10 outside R.
distractorRationale.b: The supplied conditions do settle the claim. Only 6 of the 16 S interpreters are in both groups, leaving 10 outside R.
